items.title: Earl Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: Now Quincy Jones in his autobiography he mentions his stint with Lionel and he said they were making fifteen dollars a night.

ctx.x: Yes. So he got with Lionel. Yeah that was a band. They always, the musicians loved to come to San Francisco. See he would come here and do the Golden Gate Theater, do their show there. He would do that, oh man he was a regular there. And the men loved to come to San Francisco because we had one of the highest theater scales. Yes. So when they’d come here they’d be downtown buying socks, underwear, shirts. Because when they were on the road they didn’t make very much. Now Quincy Jones in his autobiography he…
Right. And sometimes you’d have to pay your own food.
